text: Demand planning is one of the toughest jobs in CPG. Shocks come from every direction,
from surprise changes from your sales team to unpredictable retailers and supply challenges.
Today, operations and sales teams work in disconnected systems,
like trade promotion management software and demand planning tools,
that don't talk to each other or bring in real-time data.
We built the demand planning module to give it demand planners an independent but connected
view of demand, a seamless integration of retailer and distributor data alongside sales
intelligence. Confido's platform allows demand planners to
build plans with dynamic inputs, including order history, promotions, sales opportunities,
and customer inventory levels. Seamlessly run the entire SNOP process with collaborative
review boards to look over historical accuracy and upcoming activity, explain historical variances
in language that resonates with commercial and operations teams, and get alerted to areas where
you can act in real time. Additional highlights of the platform include top-down editing with
intelligent apportioning, the ability to switch between leveraging order history and consumption
as your forecasting method, alongside dynamic scenario planning. Confido's demand planning
